title: Graduate Admissions, Fall 2027
about: AUC graduate admissions for Fall 2027: early deadline December 15, 2026, regular deadline April 1, 2027. Fellowship cycle 1 runs December 22, 2026 to January 17, 2027; decisions usually follow three to four months after submission.
requirements: Graduate application must be submitted at least two weeks before the fellowship deadline
Applications submitted after a deadline are evaluated at the next deadline
